RankForgeEnterprise Laravel SEO & GEO Engine

Dynamic meta tags, Schema.org JSON-LD, streaming XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and llms.txt for modern AI search engines.

Get Started
View on GitHub
🏷️

Dynamic Meta Tags

Complete control over titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, robots directives, OpenGraph, and Twitter cards with fallback cascading.

📜

Strongly-Typed JSON-LD

Schema.org generators for WebSite, Organization, Article, Product, FAQPage, HowTo, Breadcrumbs, and comprehensive @graph builder.

🗺️

High-Volume XML Sitemaps

Memory-safe Eloquent cursors, automatic 50k-URL chunking, image/video/news extensions, and instant IndexNow search engine pinging.

🤖

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

First-class support for /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt to optimize your content for AI crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and Perplexity.

⚡

Headless & Inertia.js Ready

Direct JSON serialization and Blade directives (@rankforgeHead) out of the box for Blade, Vue, and React frontends.

🛡️

Environment-Safe Indexing

Automatic enforcement of noindex, nofollow in local, testing, and staging environments to prevent test leakage.
